# WHY THIS EXISTS: the binary is compiled /GR- - Ghidra's
# RecoverClassesFromRTTIScript / RTTIWindowsClassRecoverer always reports
# "does not contain RTTI" (verified 2026-07-12 and re-verified by byte scan
# 2026-08-18: the only .?AV descriptors are the CRT/ATL runtime's own 8).
# Instead, every vtable is found from its ctor install (`mov [reg], imm32`
# with the immediate pointing at a code-pointer array), and slot walks stop
# at the next installed vtable - the packed-.rdata boundary that makes
# fixed-length reads overrun (Projectile.h / Effects.h trap).
#
# Validated against all five hand-proven vtables (CButtonWidget 0x551e44,
# CProjectile 0x555c34, CFlameEffect 0x555ef0, CSuperFlameEffect 0x5560bc,
# CRiderEffect 0x5564bc) - exact slot counts and identities.
#
# HEADLINE: 160 vtables in the game-class region (0x551000-0x558000);
# 365 distinct carved slot targets; 106 distinct UNCARVED slot targets of
# which 86 have NO reference anywhere in src/ - virtual-dispatch-only code
# the port has never seen (the same blind-spot class as the four effect
# Draw/Tick bodies ported in f7b8944 and the never-wired panel Updates of
# session 17/20).  Clusters: 0x403xxx (early COM/D3D-style wrappers),
# 0x46xxxx-0x48xxxx (the per-weapon new(0x50) effect classes' Tick/Draw),
# 0x4edxxx-0x4eexxx, 0x4fdxxx-0x50xxxx (widget/panel virtuals).
#
